title: Paragraph-preserving word shuffles reproduce long-lag EVA gap correlations
statement: Use the 615 paired paragraph loci on 31 public practice folios that have only unambiguous raw EVA characters in both ZL and Takahashi. Put one space between words and omit page joins in the primary analysis. Measure Pearson correlations of successive occurrence-gap series at lags 1–40. Pool lagged moment pairs across pages while keeping both endpoints and the gaps inside the page. Compare 99 replicates each of global word shuffle, whole-line shuffle within pages, word shuffle within paragraphs, line-level glyph-slot shuffle, the pinned self-citation procedure, and stationary whole-word copying. The layout, symbols, and analysis windows are fixed before the runs.
check: Replicate the stored curves and aggregate late-lag ranks on public data. For a registered follow-up, freeze an explicit null that preserves paragraph word stock and line length and demonstrate sensitivity to a positive gap-order signal on layouts with the manuscript’s gap counts. Distinguish word-level conditioning from line-glyph conditioning.
source: Vladimír Matlach, Barbora Anna Janečková and Daniel Dostál, The Voynich Manuscript: Symbol Roles Revisited (2022), Figure 4 and Tables 3–4. https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pone.0260948
findings: The mean within-page autocorrelation at lags 21–40 is 0.0502 in ZL and 0.0501 in Takahashi. Against a global word shuffle the means of the controls are near −0.001 and both upper-tail ranks are 0.01. Page-line and paragraph-word shuffles give means of approximately 0.057 in both transcriptions (upper-tail ranks at least 0.99). Line-glyph-slot shuffles yield 0.0450 and 0.0446, leaving residuals of 0.0052 and 0.0055 at rank 0.01. The stationary exact-copy control is near zero. The pinned self-citation procedure has larger within-page means of 0.0885 and 0.0893. Flattening across pages gives a similar ranking of the shuffles, while self-citation is then close to the original. All-lag and space-only summaries are reported separately.
controls: Global word shuffles keep the inventory of whole tokens and all destination line word counts. Whole-line shuffles keep line contents and a page inventory. Paragraph word shuffles keep paragraph word stock and destination line word counts. The line glyph-slot shuffle keeps exact raw character counts and space slots within each line while redistributing its glyphs. The pinned self-citation control edits nearby forms and resets per page. The fitted stationary control draws from the paired training edition’s pooled word stock and copies a randomly chosen form among the previous 30 tokens with probability 0.33. Both procedures use the destination line word counts. The self-citation implementation in the repository is a separate control from the artificial sample described in the paper.
sensitivity: Synthetic rate-only changes at block rates 2.5% and 7.5% were detected in 24 of 24 trials by global position shuffles and 1 of 24 by block-conditioned position shuffles at alpha=0.05. With constant independent rates all three synthetic tests rejected 1 of 24. For the serial-gap injection, AR-ranked gap ordering holds each block’s hit count, span, and gap histogram fixed. The initial 2,200-position positive-control blocks did not produce positive correlation averaged over lags 21–40 under this finite-block construction. A separately seeded 22,000-position supplement retains a positive average of 0.379, and all three nulls reject 24 of 24 times. Thus the short-block experiment leaves positive long-lag detection power on manuscript-sized layouts unestablished.
interpretation: The common test uses raw EVA characters, including separate c and h, chosen with at least 1,000 training occurrences in both readings. The pinned IVTFF parser splits uncertain word separators by default. A coefficient requires at least 30 pairs. The aggregate equally weights retained character-lag cells on the support shared by the observed case and all controls. Word spaces are separate from the character aggregate. Report empirical upper-tail ranks and null intervals, with no decisions based on individual lags. The nulls preserve different margins, so the differences across their means do not isolate causal contributions. The experiment is a public conditional comparison and does not determine whether the manuscript encodes language.
reproduction: Write python to voynich_gap_analysis.py, python_surrogates to voynich_gap_surrogates.py and results.plan to plan.json. From a pinned checkout run OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 PYTHONHASHSEED=0 PYTHONPATH=. python3 voynich_gap_analysis.py plan.json result.json. Use the stored NumPy version. For the independent long-block supplement call sensitivity({**plan, **results.long_block_sensitivity.overrides}, scenarios=("dependent_gap_order",)). Numeric results in this file are rounded to seven decimal places. A rerun reproduced the unrounded analysis to within 1e-11.
